verdict_reason: Compared pyMack omega_i_max(R) against the digitized Mack Fig.10.3 paper curve (M=1.3, psi=45 deg) over the positive-growth overlap R in [500, 1511] (4 pyMack samples). Median relative error 1.3% (mean 2.2%, max 4.9%, MAE 2.48e-05 on omega_i scale). Topology: single rising-then-plateauing first-mode branch present in both (pyMack peak ~R=1300, paper peak ~R=1343). LOW-R DIVERGENCE (honest): pyMack is stable (omega_i_max<=0) at R<=300 under the table_11_1 schedule, where the hand-digitized paper curve still reports positive growth; those 2 stable points are EXCLUDED from the median (comparing sign-flipped near-zero values would be physically meaningless and would otherwise dominate the relative error). The rigorous Table-10.1 8th-order anchor agrees to 0.91% (perfect), corroborating the curve match.
